description: This file contains implementation of MKLDNN graph rewriting passes for PyTorch JIT, including functions for inserting pre-packed convolution operations, fusing operations, and dead code elimination.

methods.name: getSizesOf
methods.description: Retrieves the sizes of a tensor input at a specified index in a node.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConvOpForNode
methods.description: Inserts pre-packed convolution operations for a given node if conditions are met.

methods.name: isTensorTypeCPU
methods.description: Checks if all tensor inputs of a node are on CPU device.

methods.name: insertPrePackedConvOp
methods.description: Recursively inserts pre-packed convolution ops in a block.

methods.name: insertMkldnnPrePackedConv2dOp
methods.description: Inserts MKLDNN pre-packed Conv2d operations into a graph.

methods.name: insertMkldnnPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts MKLDNN pre-packed operations into a graph.

methods.name: FuseReluWithPackedOps
methods.description: Fuses ReLU with packed convolution operations in a graph.

methods.name: PrePackingOpsFolder
methods.description: Folds pre-packing operations in a graph for optimization.

methods.name: FoldPrePackingOps
methods.description: Applies pre-packing operation folding to a graph.

methods.name: FuseConvWithEltwise
methods.description: Main function to fuse convolution with element-wise operations, including pre-packed ops and ReLU fusion.
